text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Ah. No, forgive me. I'm just a little 
short on sleep.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Still... I'll be fine. I'll be sure to 
reset my mindset..."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh? ...Ah, sorry. What did you just 
say?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She even missed a word she would normally 
catch. Lucky Lilac doesn't seem to be 
getting much rest...
